title: What Do We Expect from LLMs? Mapping the Design of LLM Benchmarks
description:
arXiv:2609.19182v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Benchmarks are central to how progress in large language models (LLMs) is assessed and communicated. Yet model rankings alone reveal little about how evaluation requirements themselves are changing. The expanding variety of benchmarks offers another perspective: what researchers expect LLMs to do, and what they count as successful performance.
